paper.title_en: Quasinormal Ringing of de Sitter Braneworlds
paper.abstract_en: Compared with the Poincaré braneworld, the de Sitter (dS) braneworld aligns more closely with the present universe characterized by a small but finite cosmological constant; to explore the quasinormal ringing properties within the dS brane scenario, we investigate gravitational perturbations in both thin and thick dS brane configurations. Analysis of the perturbation equations reveals that the effective potential along the extra dimension exhibits the shape of a Pöschl-Teller potential, asymptotically approaching a constant value (mass gap) at infinity, and in particular this mass gap can be reduced. Analytical calculations further indicate that the gravitational perturbations, apart from the zero mode, possess a series of discrete, purely imaginary quasinormal modes in the late stages, implying that these perturbations decay without oscillation over time; the analytical findings also demonstrate that the brane structure primarily determines the distribution of the quasinormal spectrum while preserving the purely imaginary nature of the quasinormal frequencies. Subsequently, we further simulate the gravitational wave signal by numerically evolving the perturbation equations, which yields late-stage results consistent with the analytical predictions. Interestingly, these quasinormal modes carry information about the cosmological constant on the brane, which provides a potential new pathway for the study of cosmology in the dS brane scenario.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在dS膜世界场景下系统研究引力扰动的准正规模式，解析推导与数值演化相互印证，并指出准正规频率携带宇宙学常数信息，理论层次与分析完整性较好，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: de Sitter膜世界的准正规振铃
decision.abstract_zh: 与Poincaré膜世界相比，de Sitter（dS）膜世界更贴近当前由一个很小但有限的宇宙学常数所表征的宇宙；为探究dS膜场景中的准正规振铃性质，我们研究了薄dS膜与厚dS膜两种构型下的引力扰动。对扰动方程的分析表明，沿额外维方向的有效势呈现Pöschl-Teller势的形状，在无穷远处渐近趋于一个常数值（质量间隙），并且特别地该质量间隙可以被减小。解析计算进一步表明，除零模外，引力扰动在晚期具有一系列离散的、纯虚的准正规模式，这意味着这些扰动随时间衰减而不发生振荡；解析结果还表明，膜结构主要决定准正规谱的分布，同时保持准正规频率的纯虚性质。随后，我们通过数值演化扰动方程进一步模拟引力波信号，得到的晚期结果与解析预言一致。有趣的是，这些准正规模式携带了膜上宇宙学常数的信息，这为dS膜场景下的宇宙学研究提供了潜在的新途径。
